source.title: AR6 WG1, Chapter 7 — GWP-100. CO2, methane and N2O are taken from Table 7.15, whose values include carbon cycle responses and the chemical effects of CH4 and N2O; the remaining species are taken from Supplementary Material Table 7.SM.7, which Table 7.15 names as the full table and which agrees with it for every halogenated species. Per-value citations are recorded on each entry.
source.license: Factual constants reproduced with attribution; IPCC permits reproduction of AR figures/tables with citation.

verification.method: Text extracted from the IPCC AR6 WG1 Chapter 7 and Chapter 7 Supplementary Material PDFs with pdftotext -layout, then every value compared against the GWP-100 column of the table cited on that value. All 14 values matched. Verification also corrected the set-level citation and the climate-carbon feedback flag: the original entry cited Table 7.SM.7 for methane, but that table publishes a single CH4 value of 27.9 with no fossil / non-fossil split, because it deliberately excludes the carbon content of the methane. The 29.8 and 27.0 values are from Table 7.15.
verification.notes: AR6 differs from AR5 in including carbon cycle responses in its headline emission metrics, so this set is flagged as including climate-carbon feedback while AR5 is not. Table 7.15 gives HFC-134a as 1526 and Table 7.SM.7 as 1530; these are the same figure at different precision, and the supplementary value is used for consistency with the other halogenated species.

values.note: Published as 29.8 ± 11. Not available in Table 7.SM.7, which gives a single unsplit CH4 value of 27.9.
The table's 'CH4-non fossil' row, published as 27.0 ± 11. This library's MethaneBiogenic member maps to it, and to AR5's plain 'Methane' row.
Published as 273 ± 130. Table 7.SM.7 gives the same value.
